The '''Plexis system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Plexis/Legends|Plexis]], which served as the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[House Neuvalis]], a chapter house of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]].<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Plexis [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
